sub_sector.value: Payment automation; banknote security; product authentication and traceability

manufacturing_type.detail: Integrates and assembles detection and payment systems and uses specialized materials and equipment to produce banknotes and micro-optic security features.

production_model.detail: Designs and supplies secure banknotes for central banks.

product_complexity.detail: Combines advanced sensing and proprietary image recognition with patented micro-optic security features and supply-chain inspection technology.

production_role.detail: Supplies finished banknotes and integrated systems, plus micro-optic security features and coin and currency validators for integration.

end_market_exposure.detail: Serves retail, amusement, central banks, governments, life sciences, food and beverage production, and transport.

notes: Make-to-order is inferred from banknote design for central banks, and production scheduling for payment and inspection equipment is unclear.
